banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo/background must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
LAYOUT SAFE ZONE (critical): the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Put NOTHING important there - only continuation of the background. ALL text lines, faces, the book and the CTA button must be inside the middle 72% of the frame height. Keep about 6% side margins for text.
COMPOSITION NOTE: frame the shot wide enough that there is calm empty background above the headline and below the CTA button. The headline starts around 18-20% from the top; the CTA button sits around 80-86% and is fully visible with space under it.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, measured from the top): 0-15% only background. 16-30% the headline (two lines). 31-79% the split photo with the book on the border. 81-87% the CTA button. 88-100% only background. Do not put any text or the button outside these zones.
FORMAT: SPLIT-PAIN - Кадър на две: проблем срещу решение. Recipe: Две половини с ясен контраст (червено/зелено, стрес/усмивка), с хора; корица на границата. IMAGE 3 is our reference banner for this format: copy its structure and feel, not its exact scene or text. Copy the structure of IMAGE 3 exactly: two halves, unhappy left, happy right, the book standing on the border between them.
The setting is an ordinary Bulgarian office (modest furniture, plain walls, folders, a plant, everyday clutter). The people are Bulgarian office workers, natural and likeable, real faces (not models). Computer screens show generic office documents with no brand logos.
SCREEN ORIENTATION (critical): every phone, laptop and monitor screen faces the person who uses it. We never see a screen from the front while the person sits or stands behind it. If the screen content must be visible, the camera is behind or beside the person (over-the-shoulder or side view), so we see the person and the screen together; otherwise we see only the back of the phone, laptop lid or monitor.
NOTIFICATIONS AND APP SCREENS (critical - Meta rejects it as 'Spam - deceptive link'): NEVER draw notification banners, message notification icons or red badge counters (little red circles with numbers) anywhere, not even small inside a photo. Do NOT make the banner look like a real app screen the viewer is typing in: no message input field, no text cursor, no selected text, no call/video/info buttons, no send arrow, no status bar. A conversation may be shown only as simple speech bubbles or as a clearly framed phone illustration. Any other phone in the scene is face down or its screen is dark/out of focus.
SCENE: LEFT half with a subtle red tint: side view of a Bulgarian woman around 40 at her office desk, angry and frustrated, hands raised, looking at her monitor which faces HER (seen from the side at an angle): a messy text document with pictures jumping out of place and broken numbering. RIGHT half with a subtle green tint: the same woman, calm and smiling, leaning back, her monitor (also facing her, seen at an angle) shows a neat, well-formatted document with headings and a table. The book (IMAGE 2) stands on the border between the two halves, about 30% of the banner width.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline at the top, white with dark shadow, line 1 big: "Не се ядосвай на Word" and line 2 in yellow #F5C518: "Научи го"
2) CTA button: "НАУЧИ WORD →"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Word и PowerPoint за начинаещи". Reproduce it exactly on the physical book (printed paperback, slightly three-dimensional, natural shadow): same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic), unless the format below says otherwise.
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline ~3.5%, CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white uppercase text and an arrow →, centred near the bottom of the central area.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices of the book, percentages or website addresses anywhere.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each.

BOOK REALISM: the book stands as a real printed paperback with a natural shadow and correct perspective, lit like the rest of the image, like in the reference banner.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
